items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: I used a couple of bamboo flutes that I had made by hand. Um I remember working at Ronnie Scott’s [Jazz Club] in England, and uh a Chinese fellow gave me a Buddhist Temple flute, which I still have, and I used in a composition called The African- American Epic Suite for quartet and orchestra. It’s kind of a fetish to, to discover flutes and make them. Like Max [Roach] said, we’re “sound merchants” [chuckling].
Merchants, yeah. Absolutely. Have sound, will travel. So, by the mid-‘50s you’ve, you’ve uh, your first recording date’s in 1955.
